system.description: A wight is an undead spirit in the body of a dead human or demihuman. Its burial garments are tattered and filthy, and its eyes are hollow and lifeless. Each hit drains one level of experience or Hit Die; a victim drained completely becomes a wight in 1d4 days under the slayer's control.
